---
title: "Ecosystem"
include-after-body:
  - text: |
      <script type="module">
        import { getCorePackages, getAtlasPackages, getAtlases } from '../js/api.js';
        import { renderCorePackages, renderAtlasPackages, renderAtlases } from '../js/render.js';

        const coreContainer = document.getElementById('core-packages-grid');
        getCorePackages().then(pkgs => renderCorePackages(pkgs, coreContainer));

        const atlasContainer = document.getElementById('atlases-grid');
        let allAtlases = [];

        getAtlases().then(atlases => {
          allAtlases = atlases;
          renderAtlases(atlases, atlasContainer);
          document.getElementById('atlas-count').textContent = atlases.length;
        });

        const searchInput = document.getElementById('atlas-search');
        searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          const query = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim();
          const filtered = allAtlases.filter(atlas =>
            atlas.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            atlas.name.toLowerCase().includes(query)
          );
          renderAtlases(filtered, atlasContainer);
          document.getElementById('atlas-count').textContent = filtered.length;
        });

        const pkgContainer = document.getElementById('atlas-packages-grid');
        getAtlasPackages().then(pkgs => renderAtlasPackages(pkgs, pkgContainer));
      </script>
---

## Brain Atlases {.section-header}

ggseg provides <span id="atlas-count">...</span> brain atlases for visualization, each available as 2D polygons and/or 3D meshes.

## Atlas Packages {.section-header}

Brain atlas datasets are distributed as R packages. Install any atlas from R-universe:

```r
install.packages(
 "ggsegYeo2011",
 repos = c(
   "https://ggseg.r-universe.dev",
   "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  )
)
```

::: {#atlas-packages-grid .atlas-grid}
Loading packages...
:::

Browse all packages on [R-universe](https://ggseg.r-universe.dev/builds){target="_blank"}.
